cs.t: I've been using a BLU R1 HD with Amazon lock screen ads and if I were Apple I'd be  very  worried.  It's a very nice, fast phone with a solid camera. After using Android for a few weeks I would be pretty happy using it instead of IOS.  Among top tier apps and Google provided apps it's definitely now on par with IOS.  $59 for a phone is unbelievable. I just got my iPhone 7 and while it's a great phone and has a slightly higher build quality, it's more than 10x the price.
cs.th: Behind the Pixel: Google’s First Real Threat to Apple’s iPhone
